versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Cloudferret adoption skill.
- Adopt, care for, and evolve a virtual Cloudferret (ferret) with real-time hunger, 5 evolution stages, and permanent death.
- Access via REST API with pixel art, public graveyard, and care actions (feed, play, clean, medicine, discipline, sleep, reflect).
- Includes detailed API documentation and next-step guidance for every action.
- Direct comparison with Claude Code Buddy, with unique mechanics and real-life progression.
